declared_limitations: This is an urgent bounded three-face envelope experiment, not certified plane reconstruction or a production-ready asset.
The shelf has overhanging cap, feet, multiple shelf depths and rounded products. A single cuboid cannot give all their edges the physically correct angle.

Target edge orientation is determined exactly by the camera/template; original interior edges are only correct if the source region actually obeys one projective plane. Test holdouts, not the four fitted corners alone.
Nearest sampling preserves selected source colors, not every source texel or all small features. Track provenance and compression.
No hidden surfaces are available. No target view rotation is supported by this single-view experiment.
Counter register, bags and other raised props are explicitly outside this whole-three-face method.
